bullets: The Gemini 4 Argon promotional tooltip now warns that the promotional price ends soon.
GPT-6.1 Sol no longer displays a promotional badge and now states its daily limit.
The free model picker no longer freezes when it encounters rare date formatting errors.
Cloud skill definitions can now include up to 100 supporting files instead of 50.
Cloud size limit error messages now instruct you to add large folders to .freebuffignore.
Freebuff terminal balances and allowances are now displayed as whole hours instead of fractions.
Freebuff daily allowances, wallet balances, and rewards are now labeled in hours instead of Freebucks.
The account usage view now shows specific hours charged for each session and any refunds.
Cloud skill saves now reject unstoreable characters and identify the exact problem location.
